method: Construct the unique A5 conjugacy class of S3 subgroups, the ten-point right-coset permutation module over F3, and its exact MeatAxe composition factors. Compare with all irreducible F3[A5]-modules.
consequence: Any A5-submodule generated by a vector fixed by the marked S3 has only one- and four-dimensional composition factors and has dimension at most ten.
scope: This reduces, but does not exclude, a finite solvable seam kernel. Nontrivial four-dimensional candidates exist.
